title: My New Home
description: Four short recordings about moving to a new home: a visit, a school talk, a message and a furniture shop.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · A visit to the new flat
parts.intro: You will hear Mai visiting her friend Tom in his new flat.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Hi, Tom! Wow, your new flat is lovely. Is it big?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Thanks, Mai. It has two bedrooms, a kitchen and a small living room. It's on the third floor.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Is there a lift?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: No, there isn't. I walk up the stairs every day. It's good for me!

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Ha! Which room do you like best?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: I like the kitchen. It's bright, and I love cooking. My bedroom is quite small, but it has a big window.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Is there a garden?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: No, but there is a balcony. I have three plants there, and a little blue chair.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: It's perfect. Are your neighbours nice?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Yes, very nice. An old lady lives next door. She gave me a cake on my first day.

parts.title: Part 2 · A talk at school
parts.intro: You will hear a boy, Ben, talking to his class about his new house.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Hello, everyone. Last month, my family moved to a new house. It is near the park.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Our old house was in the city centre. It was noisy, and we had no garden.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Now we have a big garden with an apple tree. My dad wants to buy a dog, but my mum says no.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: My bedroom is upstairs. I share it with my little brother, Jack. We have a bunk bed. I sleep on the top!

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: My favourite place is the garden. In the evening, I read my books under the tree.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: The only problem is the school bus. Now I get up at six o'clock, because the bus comes at seven.

parts.title: Part 3 · A message from Mum
parts.intro: You will hear a voicemail message from Linh's mother.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Hello, Linh. It's Mum. I'm at the new house with the movers.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Please come at four o'clock, not at three. We are not ready yet.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Take the bus number twelve, and get off at the bank. Our street is next to the bank.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Please bring your cat, Mimi. She is in the small box in your room. Give her some water first.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Don't bring your big books. We will carry them tomorrow. And can you buy some bread on the way?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Our house is number fifteen. The door is yellow. See you soon, my dear!

parts.title: Part 4 · In a furniture shop
parts.intro: You will hear Minh and a shop assistant, Sarah.

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Good afternoon. Can I help you?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Yes, please. I have a new room, and I need a desk.

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Of course. We have a white desk and a brown desk. The white desk is eighty pounds.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Hmm. That's a lot. How much is the brown desk?

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: It's sixty pounds. It has two drawers, too.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Great. I'll take the brown one. Do you have a chair?

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Yes. This green chair is twenty pounds. It's very comfortable.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: OK, but I don't like green. Do you have a black one?

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Yes, here you are. Can we bring everything to your house?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Yes, please. Is tomorrow morning OK?

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Sure. Tomorrow at ten o'clock. What's your address?
